summary: Iteration 212 — Send Invoice to Client feature testing complete. All backend tests pass (6/6). Frontend SendInvoiceDialog working correctly with all required data-testids. Fixed missing Send icon import. Smoke regression tests pass for existing Org Billing data-testids.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Send Invoice to Client feature is complete. Backend endpoint POST /api/master-admin/orgs/{org_id}/billing/invoice/{invoice_id}/send creates share link and sends email (Resend may be in test mode). Public download at GET /api/public/invoice-share/{token}. Frontend SendInvoiceDialog shows prefilled email (from org primary_contact_email), message textarea, TTL days (default 30). Success state shows copyable share URL. Send button hidden on VOID invoices, visible on PAID invoices.
